description: Authoritative hot-reloadable biographical, architectural, mathematical, and project property graph for Luis (Freeman Alley / SkateAlley).

nodes.label: Luis
nodes.summary: Luis is a 26-year-old software and AI/ML engineer who builds software that feels like magic, splitting his free time between hiking, swimming, eating good food, and building.

nodes.label: Eli (Durable Medical Goods Friend)
nodes.summary: Friend of Luis working at a Durable Medical Goods (DME) company for whom Luis built the GraphRAG Policy Engine covering Lymphemeda Treatment Act Medicare Qualifications.

nodes.label: Corporate Finance & Accounting (Early College Major)
nodes.summary: Luis originally studied corporate finance and accounting in college before switching his major to Philosophy and Religion during the COVID era.

nodes.label: Philosophy and Religion (COVID-Era College Major)
nodes.summary: Luis changed his college major from corporate finance and accounting to Philosophy and Religion during the COVID era, grounding his systems thinking, alignment research, and Digital Twin persona.

nodes.label: 2022 GPT-3.5 Acceleration Origin ('e/acc, baby.')
nodes.summary: Luis speedran AI psychosis with GPT-3.5 back in 2022 and has been accelerating across AI engineering, deep learning, and interactive 3D software ever since ('e/acc, baby.').

nodes.label: GRAPHRAG POLICY ENGINE (Screen Mount 01)
nodes.summary: GraphRAG LLM built for Lymphemeda Treatment Act Medicare Qualifications as a practical compliance and qualification tool for Luis's friend Eli at a Durable Medical Goods company.

nodes.label: DIGITAL TWIN PERSONA (Screen Mount 02)
nodes.summary: Digital persona finetuned on philosophy and MF DOOM, operating live Twitter and LinkedIn accounts and embodied in Freeman Alley as the floating DOOM_HEAD holographic companion.

nodes.label: QUANTITATIVE MODELING AND STATISTICAL ARBITRAGE (Screen Mount 03)
nodes.summary: Bayesian state space model of mean-reverting, cointegrated financial assets that passed a $50,000 TopStepXFA funded trading application, showcased with a whitepaper hologram and live walkthrough video.

nodes.label: REJECTION STATION // MACHINE LEARNING (Screen Mount 07)
nodes.summary: Classical ML & high-dimensional embedding station featuring a deployed Hugging Face resume classifier that extracts 1,024-D vectors from a frozen bge-large-en-v1.5 backbone and dynamically swaps LinearSVC heads across 9 job roles.

nodes.label: What the hell does this mean, Luis? (1-Hour Resume Scanner & NYU Film Major TA Story)
aliases: what the hell does this mean
nodes.summary: Luis cold-emailed a data analytics CEO for a job, got redirected to Talent Acquisition, and was rejected within minutes—so he built and sent back a classical ML resume scanner within the hour, discovering on LinkedIn that a TA lead was an NYU film major.

attributes.turnaround_time: Built and sent back within 1 hour of rejection
attributes.ta_background: Film major from NYU discovered via LinkedIn
attributes.takeaway: Talent Acquisition is very likely hiding really good engineers from you. MAKE IT MAKE SENSE!

nodes.label: STATION 04 // AI DATA ANALYTICS DASHBOARDS AND ALIGNMENT RESEARCH
nodes.summary: Turning structured and unstructured datasets into live analytics dashboards and structured context to guide, coordinate, and align autonomous agent swarms.

attributes.focus: Live telemetry dashboards, structured context, multi-agent swarm coordination & alignment

nodes.label: STATION 05 // GENERATIVE PIPELINES
nodes.summary: Feeding extracted data and structured context into chained AI models to automate content production, code generation, and deterministic multi-step workflow execution.

nodes.label: STATION 06 // MULTI-MODAL DEEP LEARNING
nodes.summary: Working with open-source deep learning architectures (Transformers, CNNs, Autoencoders, and Diffusion) across anomaly detection, unstructured data mining, computer vision, audio cloning, and 3D synthesis.

nodes.label: bge-large-en-v1.5 Frozen 1,024-D Embedding Backbone
nodes.summary: Frozen dense text embedding transformer producing 1,024-dimensional semantic feature vectors for Luis's Hugging Face resume classifier.

nodes.label: Dynamic LinearSVC (Linear SVM) Multi-Role Classification Heads
nodes.summary: Nine lightweight, dynamically swappable Linear Support Vector Machine (LinearSVC) classification heads trained atop 1,024-D bge-large-en-v1.5 embeddings to score candidates across 9 distinct job roles.

nodes.label: Bayesian State Space Model (Kalman / Cointegration Stat-Arb)
nodes.summary: Probabilistic latent-state model tracking dynamic hedge ratios and mean-reverting spreads across cointegrated financial instruments, validated on a $50,000 TopStepXFA evaluation.

nodes.label: Open-Source Multi-Modal Deep Learning Stack (Transformers, CNNs, Autoencoders, Diffusion)
nodes.summary: Suite of open-source neural architectures applied by Luis for vision, audio cloning, 3D mesh/texture synthesis, unstructured text mining, and latent anomaly detection.

nodes.label: POD-01 // 3D GRAPH THEORY HOLOGRAM
nodes.summary: Modeling relational data as nodes and edges to analyze network topology, find shortest paths, and measure connectivity across complex systems.

nodes.label: POD-02 // MATRIX RANK SOLVER HOLOGRAM
nodes.summary: Performing Gaussian elimination and row reduction to identify linearly independent features, determine matrix rank, and solve linear systems.

nodes.label: POD-03 // GRADIENT DESCENT HOLOGRAM
nodes.summary: Visualizing how SGD, Momentum, and Adam optimizers navigate non-convex loss landscapes and escape saddle points to minimize model error.

nodes.label: POD-04 // NEURAL NETWORK HOLOGRAM
nodes.summary: Forward propagation through a multi-layer perceptron, applying linear weights and non-linear activations to map input features to class probabilities.

nodes.label: POD-05 // CLUSTERING ALGORITHM HOLOGRAM
nodes.summary: Unsupervised learning via K-Means and Gaussian Mixture Models to partition unlabeled data into distinct groups based on feature similarity.

nodes.label: POD-07 // POKER / GAME THEORY HOLOGRAM
nodes.summary: Imperfect-information game solving using Counterfactual Regret Minimization (CFR) to compute Nash equilibrium strategies and maximize expected value (EV).

nodes.label: GitHub 'Reverse Engineer Anything' Rabbit Hole
nodes.summary: A viral 'reverse engineer anything' GitHub repository led Luis and fellow engineers to reverse-engineer everything from toilet sensors and smart TVs to video games and critical infrastructure—steering clear of critical infrastructure in Freeman Alley to showcase playable decompiled games.

nodes.label: Classical Machine Learning & High-Dimensional Feature Engineering
nodes.summary: Designing high-signal feature pipelines and combining dense transformer embeddings with fast classical estimators (LinearSVC, K-Means, GMMs, anomaly detectors) for low-latency production inference.

nodes.label: Quantitative Modeling, Bayesian Inference & Statistical Arbitrage
nodes.summary: Bridging early corporate finance/accounting foundations with Bayesian state-space time-series modeling, cointegration testing, and automated risk-managed execution.

nodes.label: Autonomous Agent Swarms, Context Engineering & Alignment
nodes.summary: Structuring live telemetry dashboards, property graphs, and deterministic JSON schemas to coordinate, observe, and align multi-agent LLM workflows without hallucination.

nodes.summary: Analyzing binary protocols, hardware/IoT sensors, smart TVs, and legacy game engines to build cleanroom browser-playable ports and custom asset injection pipelines.
